name: Titanium.Media.AudioPlayer
summary: An audio player object used for streaming audio to the device, and low-level control of the audio playback.
description:
On Android, when you are done playing a given audio file, you must call the
[release](api:Titanium.Media.AudioPlayer#release) method to stop buffering audio data and
release associated system resources. Since 7.5.0, this method is available on iOS as well
and will release all audio-player related resources. After this method has been called,
the object should not be accessed anymore.

On iOS, you can control how the audio stream interacts with other system sounds
by setting [Titanium.Media.audioSessionCategory](api:Titanium.Media#audioSessionCategory). Since Titanium 7.5.0, this API
uses the [AVPlayer API](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfoundation/avplayer) for a more modern
and performant audio playback.

Use the [Titanium.Media.createAudioPlayer](api:Titanium.Media#createAudioPlayer) method to create an audio player.

examples.title: Audio Streaming

properties.name: allowBackground
properties.summary:
Boolean to indicate if audio should continue playing even if the associated
Android [Activity](api:Titanium.Android.Activity) is paused.
properties.description:
Setting `allowBackground` to `true` allows the audio to continue playing, for
example, if the application is in the background.

properties.name: allowsExternalPlayback
properties.summary: Indicates whether the player allows switching to "external playback" mode.

properties.name: AUDIO_TYPE_ALARM
properties.summary: Used to identify the volume of audio streams for alarms.

properties.name: AUDIO_TYPE_MEDIA
properties.summary: Used to identify the volume of audio streams for media playback.

properties.name: AUDIO_TYPE_NOTIFICATION
properties.summary: Used to identify the volume of audio streams for notifications.

properties.name: AUDIO_TYPE_RING
properties.summary: Used to identify the volume of audio streams for the phone ring.

properties.name: AUDIO_TYPE_SIGNALLING
properties.summary: Used to identify the volume of audio streams for DTMF tones or beeps.

properties.name: AUDIO_TYPE_VOICE
properties.summary: Used to identify the volume of audio streams for voice calls.

properties.name: audioFocus
properties.summary: Focuses on the current audio player and stops other audio playing.
properties.description:
If true then all other audio sources will be stopped
when Titanium.AudioPlayer is started or resumed.

properties.name: audioSessionId
properties.summary: Returns the audio session id.

properties.name: audioType
properties.summary: Changes the audio-stream-type.

properties.name: bitRate
properties.summary: Bit rate of the current playback stream.

properties.name: bufferSize
properties.summary: Size of the buffer used for streaming, in milliseconds.
properties.description:
Prior to Titanium 7.5.0, this property was set in bytes. Since the internal iOS
API moved to the more modern AVPlayer, this property now works with milliseconds instead.

properties.name: duration
properties.summary: Estimated duration in milliseconds of the file being played.
properties.description: May return `0` when playing a live stream.

properties.name: externalPlaybackActive
properties.summary: Indicates whether the player is currently playing video in "external playback" mode.

properties.name: idle
properties.summary: Boolean indicating if the player is idle.
properties.description:
`true` if the player is in the initialized state: that is, not playing, paused,
or waiting for data.

properties.name: muted
properties.summary: Indicates whether or not audio output of the player is muted.
properties.description: Only affects audio muting for the player instance and not for the device.

properties.name: paused
properties.summary: Boolean indicating if audio playback is paused.

properties.name: playing
properties.summary: Boolean indicating if audio is currently playing.
properties.description: Returns `false` if playback is stopped or paused.

properties.name: progress
properties.summary: Current playback progress, in milliseconds.
properties.description: Returns zero if `bitRate` has not yet been detected.

properties.name: rate
properties.summary:
Indicates the desired rate of playback; 0.0 means "paused", 1.0 indicates a 
desire to play at the natural rate of the current item. In addition, 2.0
would mean that the audio plays twice as fast.
properties.description:
Setting the value of rate to 0.0 pauses playback, causing the value of 
the `state` property change to [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_STATE_PAUSED](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_STATE_PAUSED).
Setting the rate to a non-zero value causes the value of the `state` property 
to become either [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_STATE_WAITING_FOR_QUEUE](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_STATE_WAITING_FOR_QUEUE) or 
[Titanium.Media.AUDIO_STATE_PLAYING](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_STATE_PLAYING), depending on whether sufficient 
media data has been buffered for playback to occur and whether the player's 
default behavior of waiting in order to minimize stalling is permitted.

properties.name: state
properties.summary: Current state of playback, specified using one of the `STATE` constants defined on this object.

properties.name: STATE_BUFFERING
properties.summary: Audio data is being buffered from the network.

properties.name: STATE_INITIALIZED
properties.summary: Audio playback is being initialized.

properties.name: STATE_PAUSED
properties.summary: Playback is paused.

properties.name: STATE_PLAYING
properties.summary: Audio playback is active.

properties.name: STATE_STARTING
properties.summary: Audio playback is starting.

properties.name: STATE_STOPPED
properties.summary: Audio playback is stopped.

properties.name: STATE_STOPPING
properties.summary: Audio playback is stopping.

properties.name: STATE_WAITING_FOR_DATA
properties.summary: Player is waiting for audio data from the network.

properties.name: STATE_WAITING_FOR_QUEUE
properties.summary: Player is waiting for audio data to fill the queue.

properties.name: time
properties.summary: Current playback position of the audio.

properties.name: url
properties.summary: URL for the audio stream.

properties.name: volume
properties.summary: Volume of the audio, from 0.0 (muted) to 1.0 (loudest).
properties.description:
This setting controls the volume of the sound relative to the overall
volume setting for the device.

On iOS, to adjust the volume of the device, set the `volume` property of
[Titanium.Media.appMusicPlayer](api:Titanium.Media#appMusicPlayer) and set the [Titanium.Media.audioSessionCategory](api:Titanium.Media#audioSessionCategory) property
to either [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_SESSION_CATEGORY_AMBIENT](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_SESSION_CATEGORY_AMBIENT),
[Titanium.Media.AUDIO_SESSION_CATEGORY_SOLO_AMBIENT](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_SESSION_CATEGORY_SOLO_AMBIENT),
or [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_SESSION_CATEGORY_PLAYBACK](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_SESSION_CATEGORY_PLAYBACK).

properties.name: waiting
properties.summary: Boolean indicating if the playback is waiting for audio data from the network.
properties.description:
This property is `true` if the player is in any of the waiting states, including
buffering, starting, waiting for data, and waiting for queue.

methods.name: pause
methods.description:
On iOS, the `pause` call operates as a toggle. If the stream is already paused,
calling `pause` again resumes playing the stream.

On Android, the `pause` call does nothing if the stream is already paused.

On both platforms, calling [Titanium.Media.AudioPlayer.start](api:Titanium.Media.AudioPlayer#start) on a paused
stream resumes play.

methods.name: release
methods.summary: Stops buffering audio data and releases audio resources.
methods.description:
On Android, this method should be called when you are done streaming a given
audio object, to release underlying resources, including buffered data.

On iOS, this method can be called for parity to release the current player
instance and it's observers. Note: If you are listening to the `progress` event,
you should remove and re-add the event listener.

methods.name: seekToTime
methods.summary:
Moves the playback cursor and invokes the specified block when the seek 
operation has either been completed or been interrupted.
methods.description:
Use this method to seek to a specified time for the current player item and 
to be notified by the `seek` event when the seek operation is complete.

parameters.name: time
parameters.summary: The time in milliseconds to seek to.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.summary: Sets the value of the [paused](api:Titanium.Media.AudioPlayer#paused) property.
methods.description:
On iOS, this method can be used to pause and unpause playback. For portability,
it is preferable to use the [Titanium.Media.AudioPlayer.pause](api:Titanium.Media.AudioPlayer#pause) and
[Titanium.Media.AudioPlayer.start](api:Titanium.Media.AudioPlayer#start) methods instead.

parameters.name: paused
parameters.summary: Pass `true` to pause the current playback temporarily, `false` to unpause it.

methods.name: stateDescription
methods.summary:
Converts a [state](api:Titanium.Media.AudioPlayer#state) value into a text description
suitable for display.

events.name: change
events.summary: Fired when the state of the playback changes.
events.description:
This event can be generated by programmatic events, such as pausing or stopping the audio,
and also by external events, such as the current state of network buffering.

properties.name: state
properties.summary: Current state of playback.

properties.name: description
properties.summary: Text description of the state of playback.

events.name: complete
events.summary: Fired when the audio has finished playing.

properties.name: success
properties.summary:
Indicates if the sound was played successfully.
Returns `true` if request succeeded, `false` otherwise.

properties.name: error
properties.summary: Error message, if any returned. Will be undefined if `success` is `true`.

properties.name: code
properties.summary:
Error code.
Error code will be 0 if `success` is `true`, nonzero otherwise. If the error
was generated by the operating system, that system's error value is used.
Otherwise, this value will be -1.

properties.name: error
properties.summary: Error message.

properties.name: code
properties.summary: Error code. Different between Android and iOS.

events.name: metadata
events.summary: Fired when the timed metadata was encountered most recently within the media as it plays.
events.description:
Use this event to receive meta information about real time streams and buffers, for example
the title of an active radio stream. Read more about timed metadata in the [Apple docs](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfoundation/avplayeritem/1389602-timedmetadata?language=objc).

properties.name: items
properties.summary: An array of metadata items containing relevant information about the current media item.

inlined.name: TiMetadataItemType
inlined.summary: An abstract type to represent a metadata item inside the `metadata` event (iOS only).
inlined.description:
This type is key-value based and is returned inside an array of metadata items.
Read more about timed metadata items in the [Apple docs](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfoundation/avmetadataitem?language=objc).

properties.name: extraAttributes
properties.summary: A dictionary of the additional attributes.

properties.name: key
properties.summary: The key of the metadata item, e.g. "title".

properties.name: keySpace
properties.summary: The key-path of the metadata item.

properties.name: value
properties.summary: The value of the metadata item. Can be represented as various types.

events.name: progress
events.summary: Fired once per second with the current progress during playback.

properties.name: progress
properties.summary: Current progress, in milliseconds.

properties.name: finished
properties.summary:
The event for any prior seek request that is still in process will be invoked 
immediately with the `finished` parameter set to `false`. 
If the new request completes without being interrupted by another seek 
request or by any other operation this event will be invoked with 
the `finished` parameter set to `true`.
